title: Salt Water Serenity on 30A's Seacrest Beach | Ocean Reef Resorts
meta_description: This newly completed townhome is located in the fantastic Prominence neighborhood off Scenic 30A in Seacrest Beach. It features three bedrooms with the ability to accommodate 11 beach going guests.  The interiors of Salt Water Serenity
description_expanded: This newly completed townhome is located in the fantastic  Prominence  neighborhood off Scenic 30A in  Seacrest Beach . It features three bedrooms with the ability to accommodate 11 beach going guests.  The interiors of  Salt Water Serenity  are quite elegant with upscale décor and comfortable furnishings. The living area is on the ground floor with a patio across its front. This open room has two sets of glass doors that lead out to the breezy wooden deck, and multiple windows throughout that provide a bright sunny look. Rich hardwood flooring offers a warm feel while high ceilings accentuate spaciousness. A classic couch and two sleek armchairs are flanked by the two sets of glass doors and face a wall-mounted flatscreen in between them for entertainment. A giant vivid print on a side wall features a big blue wave cresting wave in an exciting spiral. Two regal cream-colored chairs sit behind the couch near a set of windows beside a table with a stylish lamp. A powder room is located conveniently nearby. The open state of the art kitchen features brushed stainless steel appliances, including a side by side refrigerator freezer, a commercially vented gas range top with a thick Venetian plaster backsplash, and a separate double oven. A marble-topped kitchen island bar with a sink has a four coastal-inspired blue chairs to enjoy casual drinks with appetizers. A hardwood plank topped rectangular table with bench seating provides a charming dining spot nearby.   The Master Bedroom, a Guest Bedroom, and a Bunk Room are on the top level. The Master Bedroom has cottage styled furnishings with a comfortable king-sized bed flanked by windows and a full ensuite bath with double vanities, mottled granite-topped counters as well as a glass-walled walk-in shower. The charming Guest Bedroom has a queen-sized bed with a unique blue panel wall headboard framed in white and two antique bedside tables with lamps that feature swirling decorative metal urn-shaped bases. The Kid's Quarters sleeps five with a full bunk and twin trundle. This Bunk Room and Guest Bedroom share a full hall bath with a tub shower combination. All three bedrooms include Flatscreen TVs. The  Prominence neighborhood  provides abundant resort-style amenities. A giant shimmering 5,000 square foot community swimming pool is provided for use by fortunate guests. This wonderful residential amenity includes club-like bathhouses, showers, and dressing rooms. A Kitchen Pavilion promotes fun convivial gatherings with multiple stainless steel gas grills with ovens, a Wet Bar, along with tables and chairs for poolside cookouts. Across the 30a, an outdoor event destination known as  The Big Chill  includes cushioned couches, tables, and chairs. It regularly hosts live musical entertainment, seasonal festivities, and family movie nights under the stars.  Here you will also enjoy a vast selection of fun eateries and bars. This Seacrest Beach location is also just minutes away from restaurants, bistros, shopping, and fun festivals located in the charming Village of  Rosemary Beach  and neighboring  Alys Beach. First Floor:  Living Room with Queen Sleeper Sofa and Patio Access, Kitchen, Dining, Powder Room, Laundry. Second Floor:  King Master Suite with Walk-In Shower, Queen Bedroom, Bunk Room with Full Bunk and Twin Trundle, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo. Based on the daily temperature and at the HOA's discretion, the north community pool is typically heated for the months of October-November and March-April.
